Class EntityMutationNotificationService

java.lang.Object
org.quark.synq.EntityMutationNotificationService
Direct Known Subclasses:
LocalMutationNotificationService, RedisMutationNotificationService
public abstract class EntityMutationNotificationService extends Object
A notification service that handles publishing of events signifying changes to entity sets

    • installSerializer

      public <E> void installSerializer(String entityTypeName, Class<E> entityType, EntityMutationNotificationService.EntitySerializer<E> serializer)
      Installs an event serializer in this notification service, enabling it to recognize a new type of entity
      Type Parameters:
      E - The type of the entity
      Parameters:
      entityTypeName - The type name for the entity, as it will be given to publishMutation(String, boolean, Object)
      entityType - The type of the entity
      serializer - The serializer to use for entities of this type

    • publishMutation

      public <E> reactor.core.publisher.Mono<MessageId> publishMutation(String entityTypeName, boolean present, E entity)
      Tells Synq that an entity has been added, removed, or changed
      Type Parameters:
      E - The type of the entity
      Parameters:
      entityTypeName - The type name of the entity. Must match that of a serializer given to installSerializer(String, Class, EntitySerializer)
      present - Whether the entity was added/updated (true) or removed (false)
      entity - The entity that was added, removed, or changed
      Returns:
      The ID of the message that will eventually be propagated as a SyncService.SyncDataEvent
